# Security Policy

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Parts of Cloudflare Computer are stable and parts are experimental. Most of it is stable. The container backends, the Worker shell backend, the `ws:container` host module, the sync between the durable object and `computerd`, `computerd` itself, and the RPC package are experimental and under active development; the [status table](../packages/computer/README.md#status) has the full list. Do not rely on the experimental components for production security guarantees.
> 
> Reporting a security issue: If you find what you believe to be a security issue, please open a GitHub issue in this repository describing it.
